items.reason: Grounding checks need the source text, user query, and model response. Their scores can help detect unsupported output, but they do not establish truth or guarantee hallucination prevention.

items.reason: Automated Reasoning can validate output against formalized policies. Policy translation and rule coverage need validation. This is not a general arithmetic guarantee.
